aAtTheEndOfEach: A ¶ at the end of each paragraph.
aCommandOrSettingFontSize: A command or setting… (font size 18) · ? help
aPageCannotBeAddedTo: A page cannot be added to a past day: the journal only gets today's page
aSpaceIsADotA: A space is a dot, a non-breaking space a ring; spaces at the end of a line are in the warning color.
aTagStartsWithALetter: A tag starts with a letter and has letters, digits, - _ /
account_anAccountOnlyFor: An account is only for syncing through the server. Everything works without signing in; your files stay on this computer, plain and portable.
account_computersSignedThisAccount: Computers signed in to this account
account_ifYouForgetYour: If you forget your password you get your data back with this (“I forgot my password” on the sign-in screen). Keep it somewhere safe; whoever knows it can open your data.
account_notSignedYourLibrary: Not signed in: your library is only on this computer.
account_openAccountWithInvite: Open an account with an invite
account_theAccountEveryFile: The account and every file on the server are deleted; the library on this computer stays. This cannot be undone.
account_theServersEarlierStates: The server's earlier states of a page: “Versions on the server…” in the page's menu. When a page changes the server keeps what it was, at most once in 10 minutes, 10 copies and 30 days; the copies count in your quota.
account_thisComputerSignsOut: This computer signs out of the account; the library stays here, and syncing stops.
account_youSignAgainYour: You sign in again on your other computers. Your data keeps the same key.
account_yourAccountOpenWrite: Your account is open. Write this recovery key down or copy it: if you forget your password it is the only way to your data. After this only the profile shows it.
addedToRestartItToConnect: Added to %s (%s). Restart it to connect.
anEmailAddressAndAPassword: An email address and a password are needed.
anObsidianVaultOrAFolder: An Obsidian vault or a folder of .md files: its subfolders become collections, its files pages. The folder is not touched.
andEverythingInItAreDeleted: “%s” and everything in it are deleted, and cannot be brought back.
app_nothingWasChangedBackup: Nothing in it was changed. A backup can be put in its place from the backups folder.
app_someCollectionsCouldNot: Some collections could not be read and are not shown; their folders are left as they are:
app_theLibraryCouldNot: The library could not be opened.
app_thisLibraryWasWritten: This library was written by a newer version of Celestine.
app_thisPageCouldNot: This page could not be read, so it opens read-only and nothing is written over its file. Its history may hold an earlier copy to restore.
app_updateCelestineOpenNothing: Update Celestine to open it. Nothing in the library was changed.
app_yourLibraryWasNot: Your library was not touched. The log stays on this computer and is sent nowhere.
asAFolderOfPlainMd: As a folder of plain .md files, written beside the file.
backup_aCompressedCopyLibrary: A compressed copy of the library is taken at the first start of each day; the last 7 days and 4 weeks are kept. One is taken before an import, a restore and an update, too.
blocks_aBlockNewerVersion: A block of a newer version
blocks_theLinesHeldWere: The lines it held were put back, not deleted.
blocks_thisBlockWasMade: This block was made by a newer version of the app: update the app to see it. It is kept as it is.
changedOutsideTooWhatYouTyped: “%s” changed outside too: what you typed was saved, and the other version was put beside it as “%s”.

collection_aPageCanHave: A page can have pages under it.

collection_dragRowsListInto: Drag the rows of the list into the order you want.
collection_moveCollectionTrash: Move the collection to the trash

collection_theCollectionsCollectionJson: The collection's collection.json file. Changes apply when you switch to another tab or press Save.
collection_theJournalEveryLibrary: The journal is in every library: the pages of the days are kept here. It cannot be moved to the trash.
collection_theViewShowsOnly: The view shows only the pages that meet every one.
collection_thisCollectionShowsPages: This collection shows the pages the search finds: words, "an exact phrase", OR, -word, title:, in:, #tag, @todo, created:, property:value.

collection_whatLastRowSays: What the last row says under each column.

dropThePictureOnAPage: Drop the picture on a page

editor_aSpaceEnterErasing: A space, Enter, erasing and quick writing: each caret answers in its own way.

editor_asPrintFirstLine: As in print, the first line of a paragraph starts indented; it does not apply to the one after a heading, a list or a quote.
editor_howManySpacesTab: How many spaces Tab writes; 0 is a real tab character.
editor_itSavedThisLong: It is saved this long after the last keystroke.
editor_lineOrParagraphOne: Line or paragraph: the one the caret is in stays, the rest of the page fades.
editor_savingByHandUnsaved: Saving by hand: on an unsaved page the status bar says “not saved”.
editor_theCaretDozesOff: The caret dozes off after this long without writing.
editor_theLineYouWrite: The line you write stays in the middle of the window; the page slides under it.
editor_theRoomBetweenTwo: The room between two paragraphs, as a multiple of the font size.
editor_theRowChosenWith: The row chosen with the keyboard is framed even outside the normal mode.
editor_theTextColumnAt: The text column is at most this many characters wide (a readable line is 60–80 characters); 0 is as wide as the page.
editor_whenOffPageSaved: When off, the page is saved with ⌘S; what is typed is still saved when the page changes or the app quits, so nothing is lost.
editor_wordsWrittenLast30: Words written in the last 30 days
encryptionIsOnWriteTheRecovery: Encryption is on: write the recovery key down somewhere.

fetchingTheVersionsOnTheServer: Fetching the versions on the server…

fonts_readingSerifWritingSans: Reading serif, writing sans, code monospaced; the first of those on the computer is chosen.
fonts_theWeightEditorsText: The weight of the editor's text; if the typeface lacks it, the nearest is drawn.

forgotYourPasswordSetANew: Forgot your password? Set a new one with the recovery key that was shown when the account was made; your data stays the same, and you sign in again on your other computers.

goToThePagesOfA: go to the pages of a tag

history_thisVersionSameAs: This version is the same as the page now.
howTheAppsWindowComesAfter: How the app's window comes after Start.
ifYouWereApprovedFromThe: If you were approved from the waitlist, an access code came to your email.
inviteConfirmedNowSetYourPassword: Invite confirmed: %s. Now set your password.

mcp_whatWasThereKept: . What was there is kept as

menusTheSidebarHeadingsAndButtons: Menus, the sidebar, headings and buttons.

moveThePageUpInIts: Move the page up (in its row)
moveThePaneToAWindow: Move the pane to a window of its own
noSuitableTypefaceForWasFound: No suitable typeface for “%s” was found on this computer.
nothingIsDrawnAtTheBottom: Nothing is drawn at the bottom: focus mode. The theme and typeface buttons are still reached from ⌘P.
onRestartTheBackupOfWill: On restart the backup of %s will be restored; the current file is kept beside it.

page_dropFilePage: Drop the file on a page

pagesAreNotAddedToA: Pages are not added to a search collection: its query finds them

panes_thePageHasNo: The page has no headings. Type # for a heading.
query_andMoreOpenSearch: and more: open in the search ↗

query_searchPagesTitlesText: Search the pages' titles and text…
question: Question
saveStatusInTheStatusBar: Save status in the status bar
searchThePagesTitlesAndText: Search the pages' titles and text; "an exact phrase", OR, -word, title:, in:, #tag, @todo, @done, created:, modified: and property:value filters work too.
serverAddressHttpsWithoutAnAccount: Server address (https://…) — without an account, with a token
settingsWentBackToTheirDefaults: %d settings went back to their defaults
settings_aPressedButtonSends: A pressed button sends a wave through itself from where it was pressed. With less motion in the system's settings, none goes.
settings_allCornersAreWorked: All corners are worked out from one measure: 0 is square, 100 is the design itself, 200 is twice as round.
settings_allPlainFilesThey: All plain files: they open in another editor too.
settings_allThisOneFile: All of it is in this one file, the settings and the MCP key too. Carrying the file beside the app is enough.
settings_anEffectThatGoes: An effect that goes with the mouse pointer. The pointer itself stays as it is, and clicks land as they would.
settings_everyCaretStretchesWay: Every caret stretches on its way and settles with a spring. The slime is jelly already.
settings_everyPageWithNo: Every page with no cover gets a landscape made from its own seed: mountains, a lake, a beach, a forest, a city, a Japanese garden, a coral reef, balloons, the northern lights, space… An hour of the day in the light theme, the night and today's moon in the dark, and today's season. Clouds, birds, trains and fish move slowly. If you choose Remove cover on a page, it stays without one.
settings_everySettingGoesBack: Every setting goes back to its default: the language, the look, the sync and the MCP server too.
settings_followsSystemsLookOr: Follows the system's look, or is always light or always dark.
settings_nothingHasChangedAll: Nothing has changed: all are defaults.
settings_oneIdeaOnePage: One idea, one page. As you type, the lines fall into shape by themselves: heading, list, task. This is how the line spacing and the size of the letters read.
settings_onlyFromThisComputer: Only from this computer, with a key.
settings_opensPanelFromAnywhere: Opens the panel from anywhere. For example: CmdOrCtrl+Alt+N, Alt+Shift+Space. On Wayland the desktop may ask to allow it.
settings_saveCurrentLookAs: Save the current look as a profile
settings_showsFirstRunsWelcome: Shows the first run's welcome again, from the start, in the look chosen.
settings_slimeStretchesAsYou: Slime stretches as you type; Mizan shows your typing speed; the others are ready settings: each comes as it is. It sleeps after five seconds of rest. ⌘⇧M changes it.
settings_theLanguageInterfaceMenus: The language of the interface. Menus change at the next start.
settings_theLookWritingSettings: The look and writing settings are written as JSON; passphrases, tokens and places of this computer are not. For moving to another computer.
settings_theSameAsSingle: The same as a single .zip file: for moving to another computer or archiving.
settings_theWidthTextColumn: The width of the text column.
settings_themeColorTypefacesSizes: Theme, color, typefaces, sizes, caret and white space display are kept under a name; switch with “Profile: name” in ⌘P.
settings_timeLapsePagesWords: Time-lapse: a page's words stay in the color of the day they were written (the oldest cool, today warm); what you type takes today's color. Only on pages that have a history. v1 v2… in the status bar light a day; a double click leaves only that day's words (Esc leaves it).
settings_whatAgentsMayDo: What agents may do with each collection. A collection an agent doesn't see doesn't show to it at all.
settings_whatFileSetWhat: What is in the file is set; what is not stays as it is.
settings_whenAgentsClaudeCode: When on, agents (Claude Code or another MCP client) connect to this library: they create, read, edit and move collections and pages. What they do shows in the window at once.
settings_whileAgentMcpAdds: While an agent (MCP) adds content to a page, a band of light sweeps across the window, brighter the more is added.
sidebar_ifYouTypeName: If you type the name of an existing tag, the two merge. The #tag texts in the pages change.
slash_aMarkHereNote: a mark here, its note at the end
slash_thePagesSearchFinds: the pages a search finds, live
spaceThereIsNoSuchShortcut: Space %s: there is no such shortcut
spacesAndLineEndsAreNot: Spaces and line ends are not counted.
stats_howCountedWordPiece: How it is counted: a word is a piece separated by spaces; only the growth a save adds to the page is counted (deleting and retyping while you write may count twice). Usage time stops a minute after the last action. The clock is the computer's clock.
stats_noHourlyDataYet: No hourly data yet: it builds up here as you write.
stats_pagesWithSameTitle: Pages with the same title: none ✓
stats_pagesYouSpentMost: Pages you spent most time on
stats_statisticsAreOffNothing: Statistics are off: nothing new is counted. What follows was collected before.
stats_wordsWrittenByHour: Words written by hour and day
stats_writingUseAllStays: Writing and use. All of it stays on this computer and is sent nowhere.
sync_aFolderIcloudDropbox: A folder (iCloud, Dropbox or Syncthing then carry it) or a server of your own (cloudflare/sync/worker.js).
sync_conflictsFilesThatChanged: Conflicts: files that changed on both devices; both were kept
sync_noPassphraseYetSync: No passphrase yet: sync does not run.
sync_requiredFilesAreEncrypted: Required: files are encrypted on this computer and their names hidden; the server or folder sees only meaningless blocks. Nothing syncs without a passphrase. If you lose the passphrase and the recovery key, the data cannot be recovered.
sync_syncOffLibraryOnly: Sync is off: the library is only on this computer. The files are plain and portable; a backup is made every day.
sync_theRemoteMayHave: The remote may have lost its list. Apply if you really deleted them on another device; if unsure, wait.
sync_withCelestineAccountYour: With a Celestine account your library syncs across your computers, encrypted on each before it leaves. Accounts are by invite during early access.
takeThePageOutOfIts: Take the page out of its parent
tasks_loosenFilterTheyShow: Loosen the filter and they show here.
templates_eachChosenByName: Each is chosen by its name: from the arrow beside the “New page” button, from the palette and from the / menu. '{{'başlık'}}', '{{'tarih'}}' and '{{'saat'}}' can be used.

thePageTheLinkGoesTo: The page the link goes to does not exist

theQuickBrownFoxJumpsOver: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
